partners.diseaseBName: intellectual disability, X-linked, syndromic, Bain type
partners.mechanism_chain: FUS (HGNC:3792) —DISRUPTS→ RNA binding and processing (GO:0000977); RNA binding and processing (GO:0000977) —LEADS_TO→ Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (HP:0007215); HNRNPH2 (HGNC:4842) —DISRUPTS→ RNA binding and processing (GO:0000977); RNA binding and processing (GO:0000977) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). Both FUS and HNRNPH2 are crucial for proper RNA binding and processing. Loss-of-function mutations in FUS lead to ALS6 by disrupting these processes, ultimately causing motor neuron degeneration.
